searchText: How can the basis of an IPA polynomial commitment be agreed upon without a trusted setup? Couldn't the party proposing the basis generate a `g_1` from a `g_0` so they know the discrete log? This article explains deriving generators for pedersen used in verkle tries EIP: https://hackmd.io/1RcGSMQgT4uREaq1CCx_cg?view
